text.tspan: Compute can stop while instance identity, durable work, schedules, and pending commitments remain
Agent Applications: A Reference Architecture for Building and Operating AI Agent Systems | https://agentapplication.io
Each event routes to the same persistent instance
Most instances spend most of their time suspended

text.tspan: Plans, commitments, inputs, outputs, and checkpoints survive outside short-term model context. The platform can pause and resume work, retry safely, enforce time and cost limits, cancel, compensate, and escalate.
